name: cinder-monorepo
description: Cinder React Component Library & Showcase Monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@iconforge/core && npm run build --workspace=@iconforge/svg && npm run build --workspace=@iconforge/react && npm run build --workspace=@cinder-ui/core
scripts.publish:packages: npm publish --workspace=@iconforge/core && npm publish --workspace=@iconforge/svg && npm publish --workspace=@iconforge/react && npm publish --workspace=@cinder-ui/core
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@iconforge/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@iconforge/react && npm run typecheck --workspace=@cinder-ui/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@cinder-ui/web
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/*/node_modules
